title: Afternoon traffic and safety

items.label: I-280 NB · Race St
items.text: Multi-vehicle collision on NB I-280 at the Race St offramp, San Jose (~1:23–1:25 PM PT; CHP 1381 / FSP 0086). Injury status unknown; 3 vehicles (silver Kia, black Mazda, gray Honda); unit blocking Race St offramp; tow for silver Kia; FSP ETA ~15 min around 1:35 PM. Still active ~1:38 PM. Affects 280 near downtown SJ / Race exit.

items.label: SR-85 NB · Evelyn Ave
items.text: Collision with ambulance en route on NB SR-85 just south of the Evelyn Ave offramp, Mountain View (~1:29–1:33 PM PT; CHP 1398 / FSP 0088). White unknown sedan vs RHS wall; blocking lanes 2–3. Still active ~1:38 PM. Affects NB 85 north of Campbell (Mountain View), not Union Ave local.
